messages:
alex: deploy-bot scheduled a rolling deploy for inference-core -> prod at 2026-04-12 22:00 UTC. Tag v3.2.1. /deploy/12345 cc @sre-oncall @maria

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: inference-core v3.2.1. ID: D-12345. Use `/deploy cancel D-12345` to cancel. ETA: rolling canaries

maria: fyi we're seeing a DB failover pattern in eu-west-1, 5xx spike in canaries starting 21:40 UTC. opening incident INC-2026-148

jamal: canaries are unstable, recommend hold. rolling back canary traffic for now. tagging this for ops review. @alex?

sre-oncall: putting an ops hold on all prod deploys for 1h. marking releases with label ops_hold/INC-2026-148 and pausing D-12345

alex: ack. cancelling the job now from my side

deploy-bot: Action: D-12345 paused by user alex. State: PAUSED. Reason: ops_hold/INC-2026-148

maria: also recommend pinning artifacts for downstream services to v3.1.9 — the kv-cache change in v3.2.1 might be related. safer to pin until DB stable

jamal: if ops hold > 30m we should reschedule to the next change window (2026-04-13 02:00 UTC). otherwise re-evaluate in 20m after canary recheck

lisa: I can own the pin and the release note. creating hotfix branch and adding rollback instructions to the changelog now

alex: plan: 1) hold deploys 2) pin critical services to v3.1.9 3) reassess at 22:20 UTC 4) if not cleared, reschedule to 2026-04-13 02:00 UTC. tagging @product-ops to update customer-facing notes

sre-oncall: noted. set re-eval alarm for 22:20 UTC and will update this thread + #incidents. ops hold remains until cleared or we reschedule

maria: :thumbsup: adding canary graphs and logs to the incident. snippet for pin/rollback below:

```
# rollback / pin to stable
deployctl promote --service inference-core --tag v3.1.9 --env prod
# or cancel the queued deploy
deployctl cancel D-12345
```

alex: thanks everyone — keeping thread open. post any progress here. will unpause only after signoff from @sre-oncall and @maria
